title: prefill optimizer: introduce rule-engine, quant-fingerprint registry, and tenant defaults
author: Leah Park
release_notes: Adds a tenant-prefill rule engine and a quantization fingerprint registry. New CLI to export tenant defaults. Telemetry for prefill unit economics and safe fallback to conservative quant profiles. Backwards-compatible; automatic migration for tenant presets. Recommended rollouts: canary 5% -> 25% -> 100% with monitoring of prefill hit rate and p99 latency.
description: Context: We need deterministic, tenant-aware defaults for prefill/batching/quantization that can be safely rolled out and audited. This PR introduces a small rule-engine that codifies tenant budget and latency SLOs into prefill decisions, and a quant-fingerprint registry that maps model+workload signatures to vetted quantization profiles. Motivation: reduce trial-and-error tuning, lower unit-econ variance across tenants, and provide a fast rollback path when quant changes regress quality. What this PR does: 1) Adds pkg/prefill/ruleengine which evaluates tenant profiles, historical prefill hit rates, and budget tiers to emit prefill templates; 2) Adds pkg/prefill/quant_fingerprint: a registry keyed by model hash, signature shape (seq_len, kv_cache_ratio), and workload skew that selects a safe quant profile; 3) Introduces rwctl prefill export/import commands (cmd/rwctl/prefill_export.go) to produce tenant-default YAMLs and to simulate dry-run recommendations; 4) Adds telemetry counters/gauges for prefill.hit_rate, prefill.unit_econ, quant.apply_failures and histograms for prefill.latency.p50/p95/p99; 5) Adds an administrative migration that seeds tenant defaults from historical sampling and marks fingerprints as "provisional" until verified by canary; 6) Implements a safe fallback path: when a fingerprint is unknown or unverified, the runtime falls back to the conservative quant profile for that model (configurable). Checklist: - [x] Design doc linked (Linear ENG-3204) - [x] Unit and integration tests - [x] rwctl CLI UX validated locally - [x] Telemetry and alerts wired to staging Grafana dashboard - [x] Migration path implemented with dry-run only mode by default - [x] Runbook and rollback steps documented (docs/ops/prefill-rule-engine.md). Commits: Initial scaffolding and interfaces; rule engine core evaluation; quant fingerprint store and lookup with signer; rwctl CLI export/import; telemetry metrics and prometheus exporter; unit/integration tests; docs and runbook. High-level changed files: pkg/prefill/engine.go; pkg/prefill/rules.go; pkg/prefill/quant_fingerprint.go; cmd/rwctl/prefill_export.go; configs/tenant_defaults/seeded_presets.yaml; telemetry/prefill_metrics.prom; docs/ops/prefill-rule-engine.md; tests/prefill/engine_test.go; tests/integration/prefill_canary_test.go. Testing notes: Local unit tests and CI unit suite passed. Integration tests initially hit a flaky timing assertion in prefilling which was fixed by introducing a small backoff in the prefetch scheduler; integration re-run succeeded. E2E and canary runs executed against the staging cluster with a 0.5% tenant sample and showed no regression in p99; prefill hit rate improved for synthetic workloads. Migration and rollout plan: start with tenants flagged as "candidate" in the seeded_presets file, enable dry-run export to surface suggestions, then enable canary apply at 5% of traffic, monitor prefill.unit_econ and quality signals, promote to 25% and then 100% if stable. Observability and alerts: added rules in prometheus/alerts (prefill_unit_econ_drop, quant_apply_failure_rate) and a dashboard in staging Grafana. Security and data handling: fingerprints are computed from model metadata and anonymized workload signatures; no user PII stored. Backwards compatibility: existing tenant configs remain authoritative; this system only suggests defaults and requires explicit apply via rwctl or tenant-admin APIs when not in automatic mode. Limitations and follow-ups: automatic rollback is conservative and will be improved with a rollback window tied to quality evals; we will add a CLI diff/preview for quant profile changes. Related work: complements prefilling heuristics in pkg/prefill/shapers and the tenant warmstart work in ENG-2980. Merge notes: squash-merged after final green CI and approvals.
